method.transcripts: top-level ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl modified in last 30 days, all files streamed (no sampling); subagent files excluded
method.excluded: synthetic (/tmp, /var/folders eval/probe cwds) and automation (CI runner, headless scorer/probe one-shots)
method.owner_prompt_rule: human-origin user record, not task-notification/peer/scheduled/meta, not matching a prompt sent by another agent via paseo send_agent_prompt/create_agent
limits: prose clusters are regex classifiers; spot checks found false positives in continue-offer, decision-section and owner-step (status lines, mixed lists)
latency = last assistant message to next owner prompt; it measures agent idle time, not owner effort
owner-vs-agent prompt attribution is heuristic; coordinator prompts injected outside paseo MCP tools are counted as owner
ctx board and Maestro cover ~10 days (from 2026-09-29), transcripts ~44 days of activity in files touched in the last 30
arc-continuation Stop-hook blocks are not recorded in transcripts; arc state files are the only evidence

nudge_examples: is it all merged? arc finished?
Is it merged? Did you update the paseo plugin?
Is the arc finished? Is it all merged and updated?
Please make sure the whole arc is finished fully and its all ready merged

clusters.name: AskUserQuestion (structured question)
clusters.channel: AskUserQuestion tool -> Paseo permission sheet / Maestro
clusters.trigger: agent wants a choice, approval or owner action and uses the native picker
clusters.kind: Ask (481 calls) / Approval (247) / Owner step (86), by question text
examples: Pencil isn't running: Pen.app is installed but closed ... How should I proceed?
PR #662 hit a P20 stop (6->4). The session recommends splitting: merge the ... corrections now; hold ...
How far should I take the context evals?
clusters.recommendation: Keep as the Ask transport; when the recommended option is reversible, take it and post a Notice (owner picked it in 64% of parsed answers).
clusters.blocked_basis: by construction (the tool waits for an answer)

clusters.name: Tool permission prompt
clusters.channel: Claude Code permission prompt (Paseo sheet, Maestro permission.asked)
clusters.trigger: tool call not covered by mode/rules
examples: Maestro: "Run a command": cat ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/<note>.md; ls ~/broomva/apps
rejected: Agent "P20 post-structural r2 Stratum C"
rejected: mcp__paseo__speak
clusters.recommendation: Rare because Paseo agents run bypassPermissions; the residue is read-only commands in default-mode sessions. Auto-allow reads; keep Approval for writes.

clusters.name: Gate-handled tool calls
clusters.channel: auto-mode classifier, settings deny rules, control-gate PreToolUse hook
clusters.trigger: policy matched before the owner saw anything
examples: classifier [Merge Without Review]: git diff --stat origin/main origin/maestro/answers -- .control/asks/
[control-gate] BLOCKED by .control/policy.yaml: rm -rf on / or home
Permission to use Bash with command rm -rf /tmp/... has been denied
clusters.recommendation: Never surface; log as audit. Only escalate when the agent cannot reroute (then it becomes a ledger Approval).

clusters.name: Control-surface write block
clusters.channel: check-file-write-safety PreToolUse hook -> later prose / ledger ask
clusters.kind: Approval executed by the owner (today an Owner step)
examples: [check-file-write-safety] BLOCKED: write to '.control/policy.yaml' targets a control surface
ledger: Apply the v4 policy patch, which human-merges every other file a hook executes?
ledger: Turn on automatic memory commits by adding two hooks to your settings?
clusters.recommendation: Model as Approval with an owner-identity executor: show the exact diff, one tap applies it. Removes copy-paste.

clusters.name: Status stop, owner gives next instruction
clusters.channel: end-of-turn report with no question (Paseo "finished" attention)
examples: Toolbar and sidebar are in. Next is the board: imagery, your selection, and the agent's focus ...
`db974c5` has #757's first Codex review round running. It has frozen its tree ...
main is green on all four repos; the skills re-run passed. All four sessions are running.
clusters.recommendation: Notice, not a reach. Maestro should show "finished + what next was planned" and auto-dispatch the stated next step when one exists.
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Offer to continue ("Want me to / Should I / say the word")
clusters.trigger: agent hands back a reversible next step it could take itself
examples: Want me to open the PR for the 5 entities, and file BRO tickets for ...?
Say the word and I'll open a Linear ticket for #1.
Want me to land it?
clusters.recommendation: Take the step by default (preauth for PR/ticket/commit); prior measurement: 86 PR/commit asks, none refused.
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Handback / decision section
clusters.channel: end-of-turn "## Decisions for you" / "Blocked on you" / "Waiting on you" list
clusters.trigger: agent batches several items for the owner
clusters.kind: Bundle (mixed Ask/Approval/Owner step) - must be split
examples: Run this, or press Merge on the PR: gh pr merge 933 --repo broomva/workspace --squash ...
Waiting on you: - Sign Linear back in with /mcp ... - Merge sri#1857 after updating its branch.
(client) orchestrator tick decision tables - counted only
clusters.recommendation: Parse into one item per row with its own kind; a message is not a reach unit.
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Owner step in prose
clusters.channel: end-of-turn prose naming an action only the owner can do
clusters.trigger: re-auth, /mcp, /login, credits, reload, paste config, macOS permission
examples: `broomva handoff push` needs you to log in (`broomva auth login`).
parked until Chrome's Interceptor extension is reloaded. That needs you to unlock the Mac and reload it
Sign Linear back in with `/mcp`, so the stdlib-bypass ticket can be filed.
clusters.recommendation: Owner step with a deep link / one-click action and a stated fallback; dedupe across sessions (Linear sign-in recurs).
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Choice question in prose
examples: Scope - all 20 primitives, or start with the 5 that already have control-layer references ...?
Which do you want next?
Want me to wire AuthUIProvider and swap it in, or keep our menu ...?
clusters.recommendation: Ask; require options + default so silence is safe (79% of these blocked the session).
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Approval question in prose
clusters.trigger: exact externally visible or irreversible action
examples: Decision for you: should I merge?
Should I send it?
Remove arcan-old's stale Vercel project?
clusters.recommendation: Approval with the exact command; PR/commit/push offers should be preauthorized instead.
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Rename-session ask
clusters.trigger: agent wants a canonical session name
examples: Rename this session to serene-puma-holon-acp?
Rename this session so peers can address it?
...the optional `/rename`.
clusters.recommendation: Drop entirely (owner said stop asking on 2026-10-06); let Paseo set titles.
clusters.blocked_basis: measured: next input was the owner or nothing

clusters.name: Ask ledger entry
clusters.trigger: arc-level human dependency with exhausted autonomy ladder
clusters.kind: Ask / Approval / Owner step / Proposal (by headline+class)
clusters.latency_note: workspace asks with asked_at (n=52); fleet-reconcile median 203.8 min from opened (n=85)
examples: Merge PR 718 now, or leave it open?
Refill Codex credits so cross-vendor review (Strata A) works again?
Name the workspace app now, or keep the working name skene until the first release?
clusters.recommendation: The right shape (default + options + exhausted ladder). Make it the only Ask/Approval/Owner-step sink.

clusters.name: Idea triage (park or build)
examples: Prototype an explainer video made from a research entity, or park it?
Build a voxel-world eval harness and action recorder on Craftium, or park it?
Add conversation-level prompt caching to Arcan, or park it?
clusters.recommendation: Do not put in "Needs you"; batch weekly as a Proposal digest with park as default.

clusters.name: Maestro review gate
clusters.channel: Maestro gate (approve / block / revise) on a work item
examples: gate verdict approve
gate verdict block
gate verdict revise
clusters.recommendation: Keep; it is the Approval surface. Feed it from REQUIRE_HUMAN merges.

clusters.name: Session death (rate limit / auth)
clusters.trigger: API rate limit, expired login, OAuth org not allowed
examples: session.died error=rate_limit
session.died error=authentication_failed
owner prompt: /resume
clusters.recommendation: Auto-resume after the rate-limit window (Notice only); one fleet-wide Owner step for re-auth instead of one per dead session.

clusters.name: ARC-STATUS end line
examples: ARC-STATUS: REQUIRE_HUMAN on #851. It is green and CLEAN with P20 PASS. Next: you merge #851
ARC-STATUS: BLOCKED #842 awaits your merge after P20 STOP
ARC-STATUS: HANDBACK 1 decision
clusters.recommendation: Make the status line typed: emit kind + item ids so Maestro does not parse prose.

clusters.name: Peer escalation (agent to coordinator)
clusters.trigger: worker blocked; relays to coordinator who relays to owner
examples: STI-#### blocker: no machine credential can read Sentry or PostHog. Filed ...; it needs a human. (client, paraphrased)
fleet-wide blocker: the machine's neonctl credentials are gone (client, paraphrased)
PR ready ... P20 8/10 ... (client, paraphrased)
clusters.recommendation: Workers write ledger entries; the coordinator dedupes; Maestro shows one item.

clusters.name: Maestro loop flag
clusters.trigger: session quiet / waiting on you / failed
examples: Quiet for 55 minutes, worth a look.
clusters.recommendation: Notice; "yours" flags are Asks in disguise - link them to the item.

clusters.name: Dormant channels
clusters.channel: ExitPlanMode, PushNotification, Stop-hook block (arc-continuation / handback contract)
examples: Eve turns failing: Vertex returns 429 Too Many Requests for claude-opus-5 (2 attempts). Sonnet 4.6 worked a minute earlier. Switch model in the picker to keep t
clusters.recommendation: Do not design Maestro around these; the handback contract leaves no trace when it does not fire.
